Count Something, Feel a Little Calmer――小さなルールは「次」を決めてくれる

1, 2, 3, 4. The number goes up, but almost nothing in the world is solved. それでも、単純な作業を数えながら続けると少し落ち着くことがある。本稿は counting itself has a calming effect とは断定しない。Instead, it connects three narrower findings: anxiety can make movement more repetitive and rigid; breath counting can serve as a return point for attention; and if–then plans can pre-link a cue to an action. From there, 「小さなルールは未決定の未来を一手ぶん小さくする」という rule-design hypothesis を考える。
